purchases.inboundCreditNotesHint: Credit notes received as e-invoices. Review each one and record it as a vendor credit (debit note).
purchases.vendorCreditFailed: Could not record the vendor credit
purchases.claimQueuedForPayroll: Claim will be reimbursed on the next payroll run
purchases.receiptLinesHint: Allocate this receipt to several expense accounts. The lines replace the receipt amount and VAT.
purchases.reviseReceiptHint: The original journal entry is reversed and the corrected one is posted. A reason is required.
purchases.splitReceiptHint: Use this when one upload holds several receipts. The parts must add up to the receipt amount.
purchases.receiptLineAmountInvalid: enter an amount greater than zero (at most 2 decimals)
purchases.receiptPartsRequired: A split needs at least two receipts
purchases.receiptPartsTotalMismatch: The parts must add up to the receipt amount
purchases.receiptReasonRequired: Enter the reason for the revision
purchases.poUpgradeDescription: Create and track purchase orders to your vendors. Manage procurement workflows and match POs to invoices.
purchases.claimApproveHint: Add optional notes and approve this expense claim.
purchases.claimRejectHint: Please provide a reason for rejecting this expense claim.
purchases.claimPayrollEmployeeHint: Choose the employee whose next payroll run reimburses this claim.
purchases.poReceivedNoStock: Received, but stock was not updated
purchases.poReceivedNoStockHint: Some lines have no product, so no stock moved and nothing was posted to inventory for them. Edit the order and choose a product for stocked items.
purchases.automation.title: Automatic posting
purchases.automation.description: Receipts the system is confident about can be posted without a review.
purchases.automation.switchHint: Others wait for you in the receipts list.
purchases.automation.thresholdHint: Higher means fewer receipts post on their own.
purchases.automation.pausedBody: Fewer than {threshold}% of recent suggestions were accepted, so every receipt waits for your review.
purchases.automation.how1: Your bank and expense rules are checked first.
purchases.automation.how2: Then the supplier and words on the receipt.
purchases.automation.how3: Then how you classified similar receipts before.
purchases.automation.how4: Only a receipt above the confidence you set posts on its own.
